newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Flughafen Wien sees 1996 profit down.
newsitem.headline: Flughafen Wien sees 1996 profit down.

text.p: Vienna airport operator Flughafen Wien said on Friday it expected net profit to fall to 602 million schillings from 673 million a year ago, but added it planned to pay a higher dividend anyway.

"We will propose a dividend of 16 schillings," finance chief Gerhard Kastelic told an investor's conference. He said pre-tax profit was expected to fall to 879 million schillings from 961 million a year ago.
"We want to raise the dividend to give a signal to our investors," said Kastelic.
He added operative earnings were expected to drop to 729 million schillings from 821 million a year earlier. Sales were expected to rise to 4.04 billion schillings from 3.79 million in 1995.
The company on Wednesday said 1996 passenger volumes had risen seven percent to 9.14 million. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 258
